usageNotes: Use this before adding a PVE remote to PDM to discover which authentication realms the target cluster exposes (e.g. 'pam', 'pve', or an LDAP/AD realm). The hostname must be reachable from PDM at call time; supply the TLS fingerprint when the target uses a self-signed certificate to avoid trust errors. Requires System.Modify on the PDM root — API tokens scoped below that will be rejected.

examples.summary: Scan a PVE node by hostname with a self-signed cert fingerprint

tips: The port is optional in hostname; omit it to use the PVE default (8006).
If fingerprint is omitted, PDM must already trust the target's TLS certificate via a CA in its trust store.
The returned 'tfa' field is present only when the realm has a legacy TOTP/Yubico provider configured; modern TOTP via webauthn/totp will not appear here.
Use the returned realm identifiers as the 'realm' value when registering the remote via the PDM UI or API.
